ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The wild fox is anchored by Baizhang’s fox case, while separate uses name an actual fox or denounce a person as fox-like; the three referents remain distinct.
EvidenceBody: A fox story becomes a named public case: the story's unnamed former abbot says that answering 'does not fall under cause and effect' brought five hundred fox births, while Baizhang Huaihai answers 'is not blind to cause and effect.' Zhenjing Kewen heads a verse simply 'Wild Fox'; Huiji Yuanxi repeatedly raises 'Baizhang's wild-fox story' in the chamber to question Daxin, and Shita Xuanmi raises the same longer title in a hall address. The abbreviated case-name is a textual object, not the animal in the story and not a person denounced as a fox.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: This separate corpus sense names a wild fox, not the wild-fox case. The stored cases keep that referent explicit.
EvidenceBody: The ordinary animal remains visible: Baizhang Huaihai leads the assembly behind the mountain, draws out a dead fox, and has it cremated. The story's unnamed former abbot says that he fell into fox births and later escaped the fox body; Fachang Yu asks why one falls into or escapes 'the fox,' Hongfu Ziwen says that understanding the paired formulas still leaves one falling into the fox, and Dahui Zonggao calls the former figure that wild fox from five hundred births ago. These named predicates still denote the animal or animal incarnation, not the name of the case and not an insult directed at a person.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: This separate corpus sense names a person denounced as a wild fox, not the wild-fox case. The stored cases keep that referent explicit.
EvidenceBody: A person or group is denounced as a wild fox: Zhongan Huikong says he exposes all the wild foxes under heaven, while Deshan Xuanjian coordinates people he rejects with spirits, apparitions, and wild foxes. Nanyang Huizhong's longer 'wild-fox spirit' sharpens the personal insult. Dahui Zonggao applies the still longer fox-spirit label to an understanding, but Dahui's nested compound does not make views a bare-word referent. This abusive human label is not the literal fox body or the title of the Baizhang case, and the entry does not make each named rebuke an objective verdict.
